==Passive:Undead Blessing==
Zombie (Risen) provides a buff to all summons spawned on the map. This buff increases the damage dealt by summons and the range of summons by +25% dmg and +10% range for each Zombie (Risen) placed on the map. The damage bonus is capped at 8 placements (+200% dmg (3x), +80% rng (1.8x). The buff stacks multiplicatively with other buffers such as [[Commander]], [[Wind Dragon]], and [[Griffin (Reincarnation)]].
==Selling==
Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.
